# Vetta 0.6.24
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-25 -->

## English

### New

- Vetta has a new app icon: a small round face with glowing eyes on a blue binary background, shown in the Dock, taskbar, installer, windows and settings preview. If you used the Default icon, you'll see the new one after updating.
- Settings → Appearance → App icon adds Dark and Binary styles, and keeps the previous ferret icon as the Ferret style so you can switch back.

### Fixes

- The input box no longer gets slightly shorter when you type while a reply is in progress and the send button switches to Add to queue.
- In messages with images, App shots or files, the edit, branch and copy buttons on the side now line up with the text bubble instead of sitting above it.
- With the Chat bubble shape, very short messages such as a single character no longer show a notch where the bubble tail meets the bubble.

## 中文

### 新增

- 应用图标换成蓝底二进制背景上发光双眼的小圆脸，Dock、任务栏、安装包、窗口与设置预览都会更新；之前用「默认」图标的用户升级后会直接看到新图标。
- 「设置 → 外观 → 应用图标」新增「深色」和「二进制」两款风格，原来的白鼬图标保留为「白鼬」风格，可随时切回。

### 修复

- AI 回复中打字时，发送按钮切成「添加到队列」，输入框不再跟着变矮。
- 带图片、App shot 或文件的消息，侧边的编辑、分支、复制按钮改为对准文字气泡居中，不再被图片拉到气泡上方。
- 「聊天」气泡形状下，只有一两个字的消息，气泡的小尾巴不再出现缺角。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.23...v0.6.24
